header.heading: Annual Impact Reports
header.body: Each year we document the reach and outcomes of our programs — the girls we've supported, the stories we've amplified, and the communities we've strengthened. These reports hold us accountable to our mission.

reportCard.title: Annual Report 2024–2025
description: EmpowerHer is dedicated to equipping Afghan girls and women with the tools, confidence, and opportunities to create meaningful and lasting change.

Through creative arts, storytelling, education, leadership development, and cultural exchange, the organization provides supportive spaces where participants can express themselves, preserve their lived experiences, and amplify their voices.
